design_context: Retrospective design after the 2025 season and after inspecting the existing score-only weekly benchmark; no claim of prospective preregistration. No test-driven setting search.
baseline: Published weekly score ridge policy, Monday buckets and 24-hour kickoff buffer
feature_population: Scored FBS-versus-FBS games, both advanced rows present with finite EPA_overall_off, off_yards and positive scrimmage_plays; kickoff strictly before weekly cutoff
response: actual home margin minus weekly base home margin
standardization: 2023 training means and population standard deviations; zero-variance scale becomes one
residual_refitting: Fit on 2023 once; freeze coefficients and standardization for 2024 and 2025
calibration: Separate logistic and empirical 80% margin ranges from 2024 for each method
primary_metric: 2025 paired margin MAE, efficiency minus score-only correction
bootstrap_unit: UTC calendar week; game-weighted pooled error difference
promotion: Exploratory research only; current forecasts and ledger remain unchanged
